title: Issue a refund
summary: Refund a customer charge, behind an approval gate.

parts.title: Locate the charge and check it against the refund policy
parts.guidance: Locate the customer’s payment and check settled amount, currency, previous refunds and active disputes. Compare the request with the contract and refund policy, using the support history to establish the reason. Calculate the proposed full or partial refund and identify exceptions needing the refund owner’s decision before money is returned.

parts.title: Issue the refund (approval)
parts.guidance: The authorized refund owner decides the amount against the original charge, policy and any prior refund or dispute. Submit the approved refund through the provider’s supported route and follow its actual status. Pending or failed requests need investigation before retrying. Reconcile the final result to the customer balance and books, checking for duplicate reimbursement when a request’s outcome is uncertain.

parts.title: Notify the customer and log the reason
parts.guidance: Tell the customer the refund amount, currency and actual status through the support or finance contact handling the case. Use a timing estimate only when the provider supports it, and explain any further action needed. Link the reason and refund reference to the customer history and accounting record, following pending or failed refunds until the outcome is clear.

metadata.supportReason: Refunds are a single API call — an agent can issue one behind an approval gate.
